beat.headline: Where sunlight ends
beat.message: Below 1,000 m no sunlight reaches. In 17 years of video off California, 76% of observed individuals were bioluminescent.

key_figure.label: of animals seen made their own light

supporting: 17 years of ROV video, off California

shortlist_reason: Beat s4 is the payoff of a science piece about light and depth. A cinematic descent, a spatial lab diagram and a data-led figure are the three honest treatments. Paper, archival and mixed-media looks were not shortlisted: the subject is physical and sober.

candidates.cost_basis: feasibility=approximation; preferred assets: generated-image, generated-video, real-footage, hybrid. Photographic plates normally need a provider or licensed footage; procedural gradients and particles are the offline stand-in and look flatter.
risks: Without real or generated plates, procedural depth reads flat.
Dark grading hides compression banding; check gradients.

candidates.cost_basis: feasibility=approximation; preferred assets: scene-3d, programmatic, hybrid. True 3D (Three.js) is possible on this host but heavier; isometric SVG and CSS 3D approximate most needs.
risks: Real 3D fidelity is limited to what CSS 3D, SVG or Three.js can do on 8 GB.
Pre-rendered Blender scenes are an additional dependency.
Dark field plus thin labels needs care for small-screen legibility.

candidates.cost_basis: feasibility=native; preferred assets: data-visualization, programmatic, typography.
risks: Truncated axes or invented values mislead: every number needs a source.
A chart on a dark crisis story can feel cold.
Dashboard cards are the failure mode: keep one chart per frame.

decision.rationale: The task brief asked for a cinematic documentary direction for this demo. On the payoff beat the cinematic treatment gives the clearest identity and keeps the figure large and quiet; the lab diagram's slab collided with its own label and the chart had no data to plot. Caveat: a still undersells this direction, whose strength is the camera descent, and none of the three stills shows the intended 100-dot pictogram; the final composition therefore departs from the bake-off frame by turning the 76% into a picture.
